listing.name: Interesting Portraits Pack
listing.summary: Adds 375 modified portraits exclusive to each faction to fit the Starsector aesthetic.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 375 modified portraits exclusive to each faction to fit the Starsector aesthetic.

description:
I found out about this game from SsethTzeentach and I wanted to repay the devs and community for allowing people to try before you buy.

This pack has

345

375

portraits. All have been modified to fit the various factions or Starsector's aesthetic in general. All portraits are exclusive to each faction. I wanted to keep it immersive and complement the portraits that are already ingame.

This mod also fixes the stunning lack of shoulder birds, a necessity for ship's captains in any era.

It took a long time and lot of work, but I learned a lot and I'm happy with the result. Enjoy!

Download:

https://www.dropbox.com/s/a5ipzo852ifohu0/Interesting%20Portraits%20Pack.rar?dl=0

I give permission for anybody to use these for their own mods. My only request is credit and a link back to this thread so people know where they came from.

Changelogs

*Touched up a few others.

V1.1

*Tags fixed for mod compatability.

*Redundant files removed.

V1.0

* Initial release[close]

Special thanks to Crimson Sky Gaurdian for fixing tags and redundant files.
